title: Understanding Order Book Dynamics and Microstructure Alpha
description: A rigorous, code-first path into limit order book mechanics and microstructure alpha for quant researcher aspirants, prop trading applicants, and traders scaling a systematic book. Goes from order book anatomy and price formation through trade classification, price impact, and short-horizon alpha signals like order book imbalance and VPIN, all built on real NSE and BSE tick and depth data, with Python throughout.
